design.name: terrain_curved_v3
design.method: Transport the donor horizontal velocity from its measured heading into the desired smooth left/right heading; integrate at original timestamps. Retain donor ground clearance over the actual released terrain. Select among 3 angles and3 translation scales using terrain height changes and footprint roughness.
design.limitation: Designed goal, not an observed or guaranteed feasible trajectory. Full body contacts are tested in IsaacSim.

target.target: Synthetic terrain-aware curved recovery waypoints with desired opposite heading. Physical outcomes are evaluated without motion edits.

pose_waypoints.compression: Synthetic command compressed to <=16 original physical-time knots. No exported motion is transformed or retimed.

provenance.schedule_changes: None. Exact lane, costs, physical timing and terminal behavior.
provenance.scope: Single-robot MuJoCo/hardware adaptation; original Isaac batch/DR is not reproduced.
